verified_facts.text: Ness Walk sits on the banks of the River Ness, minutes from Inverness city centre.
verified_facts.excerpt: Ness Walk Hotel sits on the leafy banks of the River Ness, just minutes from Inverness city centre.

verified_facts.text: The hotel is a restored Grade B listed building that keeps period features alongside contemporary art and modern design.
verified_facts.excerpt: This lovingly restored Grade B listed building retains its most cherished period features. However, it also embraces contemporary art and modern design with equal confidence.

verified_facts.text: There is no check-in desk; guests sit in the lounge with a glass of champagne or a soft drink while the team handles the formalities.
verified_facts.excerpt: There is no check-in desk at Ness Walk Hotel. Instead, you’re invited to sit in our elegant lounge, where a glass of champagne or a soft drink is brought to you while the team takes care of the formalities.

verified_facts.text: Room types are named after the trees that define the hotel's grounds.
verified_facts.excerpt: Our high-end hotel rooms span four distinct types, each named after the trees that define our extraordinary grounds.

verified_facts.text: Cedar Rooms open directly onto private terraces with garden and river views.
verified_facts.excerpt: the Cedar Rooms open directly onto private terraces with garden and river views

verified_facts.text: Laurel Rooms are on the upper floors with large floor-to-ceiling windows looking over the grounds or to the River Ness.
verified_facts.excerpt: Laurel Rooms sit on the upper floors and feature large floor-to-ceiling windows with views across the grounds or to the River Ness.

verified_facts.text: Select rooms have their own outdoor firepit.
verified_facts.excerpt: select rooms include their own outdoor firepit

verified_facts.text: The Wellingtonia Suite is 90 square metres and looks onto the canopy of the 200-year-old Wellingtonia tree it is named after.
verified_facts.excerpt: You’ll also enjoy the canopy of the 200-year-old Wellingtonia tree from which the suite takes its name.

verified_facts.text: The Wellingtonia Suite has a marble bathroom with a freestanding bath, walk-in rainfall shower and twin basins.
verified_facts.excerpt: The Wellingtonia Suite includes a marble bathroom with a freestanding bath, walk-in rainfall shower, and twin basins.

verified_facts.text: The Rowan Suite is south-facing, with a separate lounge and a dining area for private breakfasts or room-service dinners.
verified_facts.excerpt: South-facing windows fill the room with sunshine, while remote-controlled blinds soften the evening glow.

verified_facts.text: Torrish restaurant is set in the hotel's original 19th-century drawing room, with high corniced ceilings and river views.
verified_facts.excerpt: Set within Ness Walk Hotel’s original drawing room, the restaurant features 19th-century detailing, high corniced ceilings, and sweeping river views.

verified_facts.text: Torrish is named after the salmon fly used on the River Ness.
verified_facts.excerpt: Ness Walk Hotel’s Torrish Restaurant takes its name from the elegant salmon fly used on the River Ness.

verified_facts.text: The Torrish kitchen prepares luxury picnics, with set-up available within a 15-mile radius.
verified_facts.excerpt: we offer private transfer and curated set-up services within a 15-mile radius, complete with luxury blankets, cushions, and elegant table arrangements

verified_facts.text: The concierge can arrange whisky tasting itineraries, private chauffeurs and bespoke Highland experience tours.
verified_facts.excerpt: Our concierge team is also available to handle the details for you, whether that is a whisky tasting itinerary, a private chauffeur, or a bespoke Highland experience tour.

verified_facts.text: Loch Ness is a 10-minute drive away.
verified_facts.excerpt: Loch Ness is just a 10-minute drive away

verified_facts.text: Town is a 10-minute walk along the riverside.
verified_facts.excerpt: We are only a safe 10 minute walk along the riverside into town.

verified_facts.text: The hotel is within walking distance of Eden Court Theatre and the Inverness Botanical Gardens.
verified_facts.excerpt: within easy walking distance to cultural attractions such as Eden Court Theatre and the Inverness Botanical Gardens

verified_facts.text: Ness Walk does not have its own swimming pool or spa.
verified_facts.excerpt:
Does the hotel have a swimming pool and spa?**

We do not

verified_facts.text: There are no family rooms or interconnecting rooms.
verified_facts.excerpt: We don’t however have family rooms/interconnecting rooms available at Ness Walk.

verified_facts.text: Resident parking is charged per car per night.
verified_facts.excerpt: Overnight parking for residents is available at £20 per car per night.

verified_facts.text: There is 24-hour room service.
verified_facts.excerpt: We provide a 24hr room service offering.

verified_facts.text: Guests can sit in the gardens at night, warmed by firepits.
verified_facts.excerpt: Sit in the gardens under the stars, warmed by our firepits.
